title: readBranding
description: Reads and parses branding.toml, resolving asset paths to absolute locations.
signature: readBranding(): { product: object, assets: object, assetPaths: object }
returns: object with product table, assets table, and resolved assetPaths
errors: Error if branding.toml is missing required tables or keys
Error if asset files do not exist
semantics: Reads and validates branding.toml, providing the single source of truth for product name, wordmark, and asset locations.
